title: Switch app theme to gray+purple and require MGP ID format before navigating to checkout

requirements.text: Update the app’s visual theme to a cohesive gray + purple palette (replacing the current black/blue liquid-glass palette) by adjusting the Tailwind/CSS design tokens so that surfaces, borders, text, and primary/accent colors render as gray-forward with purple highlights across Home, options pages, dialogs, checkout, and order confirmation.

quotes: yes can you make it gray and purple

acceptanceCriteria: Primary/accent colors throughout the app render as purple hues, with backgrounds/cards/borders in gray tones (no blue-forward palette).

Existing token-based classes (e.g., bg-background, bg-card, text-foreground, border-border, text-primary, bg-primary) automatically reflect the new gray+purple theme without needing per-component color overrides.
The DiamondIcon (♦) continues to use token-based coloring (e.g., text-primary) and appears consistent with the updated gray+purple theme on Home, Gen 4 options, and Gen 5 options.

requirements.text: Enforce MGP ID format validation everywhere the user enters an MGP ID (Gen 4 Racer dialog and Gen 5 Racer dialog): the value must start with the literal prefix "mgp-" and be followed by digits only (any length, any numeric sequence).

quotes: also make the mgp id have to start with mgp- and it has to be  only numbers but any numbers

acceptanceCriteria: In both Gen 4 Racer and Gen 5 Racer dialogs, an MGP ID is considered valid only if it matches the pattern: mgp- followed by one or more digits (e.g., mgp-1, mgp-12345).
Inputs that do not match the pattern (e.g., empty, missing prefix, mgp- with no digits, mgp-12a, MGP-123) are treated as invalid and cannot be confirmed/submitted.
User-facing validation feedback is shown in English when the entered value is invalid (wording can be simple, e.g., "MGP ID must start with 'mgp-' followed by digits only.").

requirements.text: Change the MGP ID confirm flow so that after the user enters a valid MGP ID and confirms, the app navigates directly to the existing checkout page (/checkout) instead of showing a success/accepted panel; pass the selected model in router search params so the checkout header shows the correct model.

quotes: and after you type your mgp it brings you to the checkout

acceptanceCriteria: On Gen 4 Racer: confirming a valid MGP ID navigates to /checkout with search params that include model="Gen 4 Racer" (and sets an appropriate 'from' value so the checkout back button returns to Gen 4 options).
On Gen 5 Racer: confirming a valid MGP ID navigates to /checkout with search params that include model="Gen 5 Racer" and from="gen5" so the checkout back button returns to Gen 5 options.
The prior in-dialog success state (e.g., "Mgp ID Accepted") is no longer shown as the end state; navigation to checkout occurs immediately upon successful confirm.
If the MGP ID is invalid, the app stays in the dialog and does not navigate.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Do not add any real payment processing; checkout remains a mock flow.
Keep TanStack Router routing structure intact; do not break existing routes like '/', '/gen4-elc', '/gen5', '/checkout', and '/order-confirmation'.
Backend is single-actor Motoko; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Implementing server-side storage or backend verification of MGP IDs.
Adding third-party payments, webhooks, or external APIs.
Changing product lineup, pricing values, or existing navigation destinations beyond the specified MGP->checkout flow.
